description:
Outcome: Teacher finds books by title or author and adds copies, from README and owner requirements/correction that search is missing.
Scope: Case-insensitive title/author query filtering, plain HTML/CSS/JS catalogue and add form served by existing Node server; operation-id retries and required same-origin headers. Excludes: loans, overdue functionality and UI frameworks.
Acceptance: Both title and author searchable; blank query lists all; distinguish empty catalogue from no results; each physical copy identifiable; new copy appears after refresh/restart.
Behaviour: Labelled keyboard-accessible controls, visible focus/feedback, safe text rendering, loading/empty/no-results/error/retry states. Explain uncertain saves and recover using the same operation id; never blindly resubmit with a new id.
Verification: node:test search/API cases and manual browser/keyboard/error/recovery journey. Prerequisites: durable catalogue API (A1). Assumptions: approved plain local browser UI and one record per physical copy.
Setup alias: A2.
title: Searchable teacher catalogue UI
